meta_description:
5,027 likes, 16 comments - wired on October 29, 2026: "The legendary actor Patrick Stewart, star of “Star Trek: The Next Generation” and the “X-Men” series, died on Wednesday at age 86.

Back in 2023, after the release of Stewart’s memoir “Making It So,” WIRED’s former editor in chief Gideon Lichfield sat down with Stewart for an interview in which he reflected on his years as an actor, his most famous roles, his childhood, and his own mortality.

Tap the 🔗 in bio to read the full interview.

📸: @michellegroskopf".
